title: POST /v1/billing/plan/upgrade without targetTier returns 400 INVALID_TIER
preconditions: Org has pricing_v1 feature flag enabled
steps: Call POST /v1/billing/plan/upgrade with an empty body (no targetTier)
expectedResult: 400 response with errorCode/body indicating INVALID_TIER; no SubscriptionOrg document is modified.

title: Upgrading to an enterprise/contact_sales tier returns requires_contact instead of processing a Stripe change
description: Enterprise-tier or ctaType==='contact_sales' targets are not self-serve; the endpoint short-circuits to a CTA response rather than calling Stripe.
expectedResult: 200 { status:'requires_contact', requiresContact:true, csmEmail:'sales@vibrantix.ai', hubspotFormUrl:<string> }. No Stripe subscription-update call is made and the org's tier is unchanged.

title: Upgrade is blocked with 409 DOWNGRADE_PENDING when a scheduled downgrade already exists
preconditions: Org has an active pending-tier-change document (a downgrade scheduled for the next renewsAt)
steps: Call POST /v1/billing/plan/upgrade with a valid targetTier while the pending downgrade is still active
expectedResult: 409 { code:'DOWNGRADE_PENDING', message:'Cancel pending downgrade before upgrading' }. Caller must call DELETE /v1/billing/plan/pending-change first.

title: Downgrading from the enterprise tier is rejected and points to a different CSM email than the upgrade-to-enterprise path
description: Enterprise downgrade requires talking to a CSM. Worth pinning: the downgrade-blocked email (csm@vibrantix.ai) differs from the upgrade-to-enterprise email (sales@vibrantix.ai) — verify this isn't an accidental inconsistency before it ships to more customers.
expectedResult: 409 { code:'DOWNGRADE_NOT_ALLOWED', message:'Enterprise downgrades require contacting your CSM', details:{ requiresContact:true, csmEmail:'csm@vibrantix.ai' } }.

title: Downgrade with usage over the target tier's caps requires acknowledgeOverCap=true or returns 422
preconditions: Org usage: 12 users, target 'growth' tier limits.users=10
steps: Call POST /v1/billing/plan/downgrade with targetTier='growth' and no acknowledgeOverCap field
Repeat the same call with acknowledgeOverCap=true
expectedResult: First call: 422 { code:'OVER_CAP_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED', message:'Usage exceeds limits of target tier. Set acknowledgeOverCap=true to proceed.', details:{ overCap:{ users:true, ... } } }. Second call: 200/scheduled success — a pending-tier-change is created for the next renewsAt.

title: Cancelling a pending downgrade when none exists returns NO_PENDING_CHANGE rather than a generic error
preconditions: Org has no active pending-tier-change document
expectedResult: Response carries code 'NO_PENDING_CHANGE'; no error is thrown and no side effects occur. Confirms the client's existing 'treat as no-op' handling matches server intent.

title: GET /v1/billing/invoices returns an empty paginated shape for an org with no Stripe customer yet
expectedResult: 200 { items:[], page:1, pageSize:25, total:0, nextCursor:null } — no 4xx/5xx thrown for the common 'never billed yet' state.

title: All customer-facing /v1/billing/* routes 404 when pricing_v1 is disabled for the org
description: isPricingV1Enabled(orgId) gates the whole customer billing API (env PRICING_V1 or per-org PRICING_V1_ORG_ALLOWLIST). Public plans/tiers catalog and the Stripe webhook are exempt.
preconditions: Org is not in PRICING_V1_ORG_ALLOWLIST and PRICING_V1 env flag is off
steps: Call GET /v1/billing/plan, GET /v1/billing/usage, and POST /v1/billing/plan/upgrade for the flagged-off org
expectedResult: Each call returns 404 { error:{ code:'NOT_FOUND', message:'Not found' } }. GET /v1/billing/public-plans (or plans-catalog public variant) and POST /webhooks/stripe remain reachable regardless of the flag.

title: billingProjectAccess middleware requires and validates projectId for project-billed organizations
description: billing.routes.js (lines ~56-67) enforces projectId presence and project-org ownership for orgs on the project scope of billing.
steps: Call a project-scoped billing endpoint (e.g. GET /v1/billing/plan) with no projectId query param
Repeat with a projectId belonging to a different organization
expectedResult: First call: 400 'projectId is required for project-billed organizations'. Second call: 404 'Project not found'.
